units.source_text: 话分两头，且说朱雀院让位之后，朝代改变，派赴伊势修行的斋宫照例必须易人，故六条妃子和女儿斋宫都回京了。

en.t: To turn to another matter, after Emperor Suzaku retired and the reign changed, the Saigu sent to serve at Ise had, as usual, to be replaced, so the Rokujo lady and her daughter, the Saigu, both returned to the capital.

units.source_text: 此后源氏公子对这母女二人依旧万事照顾，情谊深厚无比。

en.t: After that, Prince Genji continued to look after the mother and daughter in every way, and his affection for them was exceedingly deep.

units.source_text: 但六条妃子想：“从前他对我爱情早已冷淡，现在我决不再讨没趣。”

en.t: But the Rokujo lady thought, "His love for me had already grown cold long ago; now I will certainly not invite humiliation again."
She had already given up all hope of the prince.
The prince, for his part, did not make a special visit to her either.

units.source_text: 他想：“我倘强要与她重圆旧梦，则能否持久，自己亦不得而知。

en.t: He thought, "If I were to force a renewal of our old relationship, even I could not know whether it would last.

units.source_text: 况且东奔西走、怜香惜玉之事，我现在的身份亦颇多不便。”

en.t: Besides, with my present rank, it is in many ways inconvenient to run about here and there pursuing tender affairs with women."

units.source_text: 因此他并不勉强亲近六条妃子。

en.t: For that reason, he did not force himself to draw close to the Rokujo lady.

units.source_text: 只是想起她那女儿前斋宫，不知现在长得何等美丽了，倒很想看一看。

en.t: Yet when he thought of her daughter, the former Saigu, he wondered how beautiful she had become and very much wished to see her.
